description: This file contains source code defining error injection mechanisms for a storage provider within the Orleans framework, including enum types, data structures, a custom exception class, and a storage provider class that supports error injection for testing purposes.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionPoint
classes.description: An enum indicating specific points within storage operations where errors can be injected for testing.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionBehavior
classes.description: A struct defining the type of error to inject and the point of injection.

classes.name: StorageProviderInjectedError
classes.description: A custom exception class used to simulate errors during storage operations.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionStorageProvider
classes.description: A mock storage provider class extended to support error injection for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetErrorInjection
methods.description: Configures error injection behavior on the storage provider.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider, resetting error injection state.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads state with optional error injection at defined points.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes state with optional error injection at defined points.

methods.name: ThrowIfMatches
methods.description: Throws an injected error if the current execution point matches the configured injection point.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands for error injection configuration.
